meta.title: The Woman with the Spotted Hat

paragraphs: On Saturday morning, Mia, Leo, and May went to the market. It was busy, and the air smelled of fruit. Leo ran past a fish stall, and he fell over. His knee was sore, and it had a small cut. "There is a chemist next to the gate," said May. "Let us go there."

The shop was small and clean. The chemist was a kind woman in a white coat. She cleaned Leo's knee and put a bandage on it. "Does it feel better?" she asked. "Yes, thank you," said Leo. "Can you do something for me?" asked the chemist. She gave Mia a small paper bag. "Please give this to my friend," she said. "She sells flowers next to the water tap." "She wears a spotted hat and yellow gloves." "Her table is very untidy."

The children walked slowly because of Leo's knee. At the first flower stall, a woman wore yellow gloves. "Is that her?" asked Leo. "No," said May. "Her hat is blue, and her table is tidy." "Also, I do not see a water tap here." They walked on to the end of the market.

Next to a water tap, there was a second flower stall. Flowers lay everywhere on the table. The woman at the stall wore yellow gloves and a spotted hat. "That is her!" said Mia. She gave the bag to the woman, and the woman smiled. "This is from my old friend, the chemist," said the woman. "Thank you, children." "Are you interested in flowers?"

"I am interested in animals," said Mia. A butterfly was sitting on a yellow flower when Mia took out her camera. She took a photo of it. "Walk slowly, Leo," said May, and she smiled. Leo looked at his white bandage. "Now I have a good story for my cartoon," he said.
text.summary: At the market, Leo falls and cuts his knee, and a kind chemist helps him. She asks the children to give a bag to her friend, and they find the right woman from a short description.
